_note: fantasy1: the enchanted forest and the valley of giants (Le pays des contes, park sector). Hooks match the paintings.

fr_fee_noun.hook: Like the old English word "fay", said FAY: a tiny FÉE (fairy) in a pink petal dress flies over the pond, waving her star-tipped wand.

fr_licorne_noun.hook: "LICK CORN" (lee-KORN): a white LICORNE (unicorn) with a golden spiral horn LICKS a big yellow ear of CORN set on a tree stump.

fr_sirene_noun.hook: Plain: like "siren", said see-REHN: a red-haired SIRÈNE (mermaid) with a green fish tail sits on a mossy rock in the forest pond, singing.

fr_centaure_noun.hook: Plain: like "centaur", said sahn-TOR: a young CENTAURE, half boy and half chestnut horse, leaps across the clearing carrying a basket of red apples.

fr_elfe_noun.hook: Plain: like "elf", said ELF: a slim ELFE with pointed ears sits high in the tree and plays a wooden flute.

fr_farfadet_noun.hook: "FARFA(lle) DAY" (far-fah-DEH): a tiny green FARFADET (sprite) wearing a big yellow FARFALLE pasta bow as his bow tie swings on a bluebell on a sunny DAY.

fr_gnome_noun.hook: Plain: like "gnome" with the g sounded, said GNOHM: a GNOME in a tall red pointed hat pushes a wheelbarrow full of mushrooms.

fr_lutin_noun.hook: "LUTE TAN" (lew-TAN): a cheeky red LUTIN (imp) in sunglasses works on his sunTAN on top of a red toadstool, strumming a LUTE.

fr_nain_noun.hook: "NAN": a bearded NAIN (dwarf) with a lantern happily bites into a big round NAAN bread.
fr_nain_noun.note: Said about a person with dwarfism it can be hurtful; 'personne de petite taille' is the respectful term.

fr_phenix_noun.hook: Plain: like "phoenix", said fay-NEEKS: a red-and-gold PHÉNIX with a long flowing tail glides across the sky.

fr_griffon_noun.hook: Plain: like "griffin", said gree-FOHN: a GRIFFON, eagle head and wings on a lion's body, rests proudly on a high rocky crag.

fr_geant_noun.hook: "JAY ON!" (zhay-AHN): a blue JAY perches ON the thumb of a kindly GÉANT (giant) sitting on a boulder.

fr_troll_noun.hook: Plain: like "troll", said TROLL: a mossy green TROLL stands waist-deep in the stream beside the stone footbridge and waves hello.

fr_ogre_noun.hook: Plain: like "ogre", said OGR: a friendly OGRE with small tusks sits on a log and reads a picture book to three little mice.

fr_dragon_noun.hook: Plain: like "dragon", said drah-GOHN: a friendly green DRAGON wearing a daisy chain sleeps smiling on the grass.
